text: All four heads carry causal weight (denoising effects 0.30-0.46, E0006; joint mean ablation leaves 0.17 for layer 1, E0009, and 0.27 for layer 0, E0010). Layer-1 heads attend from the last position to the winning token (0.83 / 0.92, E0008). Layer-0 heads have ~0 direct effect on the logits (0.004 / 0.006) and layer-1 heads only ~0.10 each (E0012), so the answer is finalised downstream of attention (mlp1). REFUTED prediction N0020: I expected layer-0 heads not to feed layer-1 values; in fact V-composition is the main route for the layer-0 heads (0.18 / 0.23 of their 0.30 / 0.36 total, E0013). Revised picture: layer-0 heads pre-process the per-position representations that layer-1 heads then move to the last position.

text: t7 priority-max, full circuit: not-verified. The thresholds were met, but these effects do not exceed the 95th percentile of their null distribution: sufficiency. A random control does about as well, so this is not a finding.

V0001: function agreement 1.0 on held-out seed 2; whole-model circuit (6/6 components) meets thresholds but sufficiency has no null (circuit = whole model), so status not-verified. Every component showed a causal effect in my experiments, so I do not believe any is a pure dummy. One follow-up, decided before seeing it: test the 5-component circuit that drops the weakest component, head 0.0 (smallest single-ablation loss in E0003, smallest patching effect in E0006), on unused seed 3. Expectation: circuit-alone fraction near 0.69, i.e. borderline against the 0.7 threshold. I will report the outcome either way and not try further subsets to hunt for a pass.
t7 priority-max, circuit without head 0.0: not-verified. At least one check failed; the explanation is partial or wrong. See the numbers.

H1 supported: predict() agrees with the model on 200/200 held-out inputs in V0001 (seed 2) and 200/200 in V0002 (seed 3). Circuit localisation is NOT verified: whole model has no sufficiency null (V0001); dropping head 0.0 leaves 0.682 of the logit difference and 96.5% accuracy, just under the 0.7 threshold (V0002). Conclusion: all six components take part; no dummy component found at head/MLP granularity. Stopping here as decided in N0031.
